notes.title: Rob Riches: The Anniversary Update
notes.content:
Hello fellow adventurers!
We are beyond excited to announce a major update to Rob Riches! 

The anniversary update adds major new content to the game, inducing full controller support, cinematics, new assets, steam deck support, quality of life changes and a few fixes and tweaks. 

We've also made an updated trailer to showcase all the accolades accrued by Rob Riches since it's original release! Take a look: 

[previewyoutube=h3RbWnK9cV0;full][/previewyoutube]

We will be sharing a lot of Rob content these coming weeks, including some behind the scenes looks into the creative process behind the game. Rob's creation is already up on our Twitter, TikTok and Instagram, with more to come very soon! So make sure to keep up with us over on [url=https://twitter.com/MegapopGames]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@megapopgames]TikTok[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/megapopgames/]Instagram[/url] and [url=facebook.com/Megapopgames/]Facebook[/url] to see more of Rob's escapades! 

We hope you all enjoy this update!

notes.title: December 14. Update
notes.content:
We have spent the last few weeks watching a ton of streamers and youtubers play our game, it's really fun watching people enjoy the game and come together to solve the puzzles. 

We have seen and heard that especially [b]level 2-29[/b] has been a wall for a lot of people [i](we saw a couple of streamers spend an hour on this level alone, but they endured and succeeded, which is crazy! Thank you for being so persistent)[/i]. We made some changes to help improve this puzzle and it's onboarding. 

We have also gotten some valuable feedbacks on other things, thank you guys for being vigilant and reporting issues you find!

[list]
[*] Minor changes to level 2-29 (now level 2-30), the puzzle is still the same, but with a minor adjustment it might be easier to read (crossing fingers*).
[*] We added a new level 2-29 before the really difficult one, to better prepare levels for the incoming challenge!
[*] We updated the implementation of keybindings and how they are presented in the menu, now correct key should be displayed according to your keyboard.
[*] Level 2-23 has been changed a little bit, but we forgot to update the "best score" for it!
[/list]

notes.title: November 22nd Update
notes.content:
Normally Erlend writes these, but I really wanted to get this update out, so this update post was written by ITR! 

That means I get to write whatever I want! Mohahah!

[list]
[*] Updated step count for level 1-22, Thank you Na for finding a 58 step solution!
[*] Merged Mouse-Only mode and DPAD mode, and made a separate toggle for always showing mouse! Thank you ak-ryuu for pointing out it was confusing, and also BadCodePlays on youtube for showing the mouse cursor issues!
[*] Made right click double as left click, made the spacebar double as enter, and IJKL work as WASD/Arrow Keys, to hopefully cover some more ground there! Thank you Медведев for inspiring this!
[*] [spoiler]Also made a super tiny thing happen if you hover over my name in the credits, but sshh, I didn't tell anyone else about this so keep it between us >.>[/spoiler] <-- DO NOT CLICK THIS IF YOU WORK FOR MEGAPOP! And don't check any commits related to the credits-page! [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40876951/c381db4bbb4b6c2638c29898122d7de2c31f571c.gif[/img]
[*] (Hopefully) fixed a bug causing the game to get stuck when going from one world to another! Thank you very much ak-ryuu for reporting this bug after experiencing! ❤️❤️❤️!
[/list]

Hope you all enjoy the update! Please keep us updated on bugs and stepcounts that need to be updated! 
See you all on the forums, ~ITR  [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40876951/b91cf1a94cdc696c2e3a673be8ed80983728bed3.gif[/img]

Remember that you can find us an share your feedback [url=https://discord.gg/P4aTmj8 ]in our Discord community[/url].

notes.title: November 19. Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone, hope you enjoy solving our puzzles in Rob Riches. We have made a few updates to the game that are live now:

[list]
[*] Added optimal step counts for each level in the level list, this is what we developers [i]think[/i] are the best possible solutions for each level. This is a nice reference for people to maximize their own steps, and is an open challenge to try and find better solutions than we have!
[*] Added one more secret and achievement!
[*] Added more settings for graphics.
[*] Fixed an unintended level solution [i](this has been taken into consideration for minimum step count)[/i]
[*] Fixed multiple visual bugs.
[/list]

Thank you all for playing ;)
